column1: The continuous and reckless use of synthetic chemicals for the control of pests which pose a threat to agricultural crops and human health is proving to be counter-productive.
column2: 人们持续而不加节制地使用合成化学品来防治害虫。这些害虫会威胁农作物和人类健康，而事实正表明，这样用药反而适得其反。
column7: pose a threat to|对……构成威胁
column10: is proving to be|事实正表明是

column1: Apart from engendering widespread ecological disorders, pesticides have contributed to the emergence of a new breed of chemical-resistant, highly lethal superbugs.
column2: 杀虫剂除了引发大范围的生态失调，还促成了一类新害虫的出现：这些“超级害虫”对化学药剂有抗性，杀伤力极强。
column11: chemical-resistant|adj. 对化学药剂有抗性的
column13: superbugs|n. 此处指抗药性强的超级害虫

column1: According to a recent study by the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), more than 300 species of agricultural pests have developed resistance to a wide range of potent chemicals.
column2: 据联合国粮食及农业组织近期的一项研究，已有三百多种农业害虫对多种强效化学药剂产生了抗性。
column9: a wide range of|多种多样的

column1: Not to be left behind are the disease-spreading pests, about 100 species of which have become immune to a variety of insecticides now in use.
column2: 传播疾病的害虫也不例外：其中约有一百种已对目前使用的多种杀虫剂产生了抗性。
column3: Not to be left behind|也不例外；同样如此

column1: One glaring disadvantage of pesticides’ application is that, while destroying harmful pests, they also wipe out many useful non-targeted organisms, which keep the growth of the pest population in check.
column2: 施用农药有一个明显的弊端：在消灭害虫的同时，也会消灭许多本不在防治范围内的有益生物，而这些生物原本能抑制害虫种群增长。

column1: This results in what agroecologists call the ‘treadmill syndrome’.
column2: 由此便出现了农业生态学家所说的“农药恶性循环”。
column5: treadmill syndrome|此处指越用农药越依赖用药的恶性循环

column1: Because of their tremendous breeding potential and genetic diversity, many pests are known to withstand synthetic chemicals and bear offspring with a built-in resistance to pesticides.
column2: 由于害虫有着巨大的繁殖潜力和丰富的遗传多样性，人们已知其中许多害虫能耐受合成化学药剂，还能繁衍出天生就对农药有抗性的后代。

column1: The havoc that the ‘treadmill syndrome’ can bring about is well illustrated by what happened to cotton farmers in Central America.
column2: 中美洲棉农的经历清楚地说明了这种“农药恶性循环”会造成多么严重的破坏。

column1: In the early 1940s, basking in the glory of chemical-based intensive agriculture, the farmers avidly took to pesticides as a sure measure to boost crop yield.
column2: 20世纪40年代初，棉农陶醉于依靠化学品的集约化农业所取得的成就，热衷于使用农药，把它看作提高作物产量的可靠办法。
column3: basking in the glory of|沉浸在……的辉煌中
column4: chemical-based|adj. 以化学品为基础的

column1: The insecticide was applied eight times a year in the mid-1940s, rising to 28 in a season in the mid-1950s, following the sudden proliferation of three new varieties of chemical-resistant pests.
column2: 20世纪40年代中期，杀虫剂每年施用八次；到了50年代中期，用药次数升至每季二十八次，原因是三种新的抗药害虫突然大量繁殖。
column6: in a season|在一个生长季内
column10: chemical-resistant|adj. 对化学药剂有抗性的

column1: By the mid-1960s, the situation took an alarming turn with the outbreak of four more new pests, necessitating pesticide spraying to such an extent that 50% of the financial outlay on cotton production was accounted for by pesticides.
column2: 到20世纪60年代中期，又有四种新的害虫暴发，情况急转直下，令人担忧。棉农不得不大量喷洒农药，以至于棉花生产开支的一半都花在了农药上。
column3: took an alarming turn|发生令人担忧的转变
column8: to such an extent that|达到……的程度，以至于

column1: In the early 1970s, the spraying frequently reached 70 times a season as the farmers were pushed to the wall by the invasion of genetically stronger insect species.
column2: 20世纪70年代初，遗传上更有生存优势的昆虫种类入侵，把农户逼得走投无路，喷药次数常常达到每季七十次。
column5: pushed to the wall|把……逼入绝境

column1: Most of the pesticides in the market today remain inadequately tested for properties that cause cancer and mutations as well as for other adverse effects on health, says a study by United States environmental agencies.
column2: 目前市面上的大多数农药，在致癌性和致突变性方面仍未得到充分检测，对健康的其他不良影响也缺乏充分检测。美国环境机构的一项研究这样指出。

column1: The United States National Resource Defense Council has found that DDT was the most popular of a long list of dangerous chemicals in use.
column2: 美国自然资源保护委员会发现，在当时使用的众多危险化学品中，滴滴涕最为常用。
column7: a long list of|一长串；众多

column1: In the face of the escalating perils from indiscriminate applications of pesticides, a more effective and ecologically sound strategy of biological control, involving the selective use of natural enemies of the pest population, is fast gaining popularity-though, as yet, it is a new field with limited potential.
column2: 面对不加节制地施用农药所带来的日益严重的危险，有一种更有效、在生态上也更合理的生物防治策略，它有选择地利用害虫的天敌，正迅速受到青睐。不过，这仍是一个潜力有限的新领域。

column1: The advantage of biological control in contrast to other methods is that it provides a relatively low-cost, perpetual control system with a minimum of detrimental side-effects.
column2: 与其他方法相比，生物防治的优势在于，它能以较低成本提供持续发挥作用的防治体系，并把有害副作用降到很低。

column1: When handled by experts, bio-control is safe, non-polluting and self-dispersing.
column2: 由专家实施时，生物防治是安全的，不造成污染，而且防治生物能自行扩散。

column1: The Commonwealth Institute of Biological Control (CIBC) in Bangalore, with its global network of research laboratories and field stations, is one of the most active, non-commercial research agencies engaged in pest control by setting natural predators against parasites.
column2: 设在班加罗尔的英联邦生物防治研究所在全球拥有研究实验室和野外工作站。它是最活跃的非商业性研究机构之一，利用天然捕食者对付寄生生物，借此防治害虫。
column7: one of the most active|最活跃者之一

column1: CIBC also serves as a clearing-house for the export and import of biological agents for pest control world-wide.
column2: 该研究所还充当全球协调中心，协调各地防治害虫所用生物的进出口。
column6: biological agents|用于防治害虫的生物

column1: CIBC successfully used a seed-feeding weevil, native to Mexico, to control the obnoxious parthenium weed, known to exert devious influence on agriculture and human health in both India and Australia.
column2: 英联邦生物防治研究所曾成功利用一种原产于墨西哥、以种子为食的象鼻虫，防治有害杂草银胶菊。人们知道，这种杂草会以不易察觉的方式危害印度和澳大利亚的农业及人类健康。
column7: obnoxious|adj. 有害而令人厌恶的
column10: devious influence|不易察觉的不良影响

column1: Similarly the Hyderabad-based Regional Research Laboratory (RRL), supported by CIBC, is now trying out an Argentinian weevil for the eradication of water hyacinth, another dangerous weed, which has become a nuisance in many parts of the world.
column2: 同样，在英联邦生物防治研究所的支持下，位于海得拉巴的地区研究实验室正试用一种阿根廷象鼻虫来根除水葫芦。水葫芦是另一种危险杂草，已在世界许多地方成为一大祸患。

column1: According to Mrs Kaiser Jamil of RRL, ‘The Argentinian weevil does not attack any other plant and a pair of adult bugs could destroy the weed in 4-5 days.’
column2: 地区研究实验室的凯泽尔·贾米尔女士说，“这种阿根廷象鼻虫不会危害其他任何植物，一对象鼻虫成虫可能在四五天内就能毁掉这种杂草。”

column1: CIBC is also perfecting the technique for breeding parasites that prey on ‘disapene scale’ insects - notorious defoliants of fruit trees in the US and India.
column2: 英联邦生物防治研究所也在改进一种技术，用于繁育捕食盾蚧的寄生性天敌。盾蚧是美国和印度出了名的果树害虫，能使果树落叶。
column10: defoliants|n. 使树木落叶的害虫

column1: How effectively biological control can be pressed into service is proved by the following examples.
column2: 下面的例子表明，生物防治付诸实际应用时能有多大成效。
column5: pressed into service|投入实际使用

column1: In the late 1960s, when Sri Lanka’s flourishing coconut groves were plagued by leaf-mining hispides, a larval parasite imported from Singapore brought the pest under control.
column2: 20世纪60年代末，斯里兰卡茂盛的椰林受到潜叶铁甲虫的严重侵害。人们从新加坡引入了一种寄生于害虫幼虫的天敌，控制住了虫害。
column8: larval parasite|寄生于幼虫的天敌
column10: brought the pest under control|控制住害虫

column1: A natural predator indigenous to India, Neodumetia sangawani, was found useful in controlling the Rhodes grass-scale insect that was devouring forage grass in many parts of the US.
column2: 研究发现，原产于印度的一种天敌（Neodumetia sangawani）有助于防治罗德草蚧；这种介壳虫当时正在美国许多地区大量啃食牧草。
column7: grass-scale insect|危害牧草的介壳虫

column1: By using Neochetina bruci, a beetle native to Brazil, scientists at Kerala Agricultural University freed a 12-kilometre-long canal from the clutches of the weed Salvinia molesta, popularly called ‘African Payal’ in Kerala.
column2: 借助一种原产于巴西的甲虫（Neochetina bruci），喀拉拉农业大学的科学家使一条十二公里长的运河摆脱了有害槐叶萍（Salvinia molesta）的侵害；这种杂草在喀拉拉当地俗称“非洲帕亚尔”。
column8: from the clutches of|从……的控制中；摆脱……的侵害

column1: About 30,000 hectares of rice fields in Kerala are infested by this weed.
column2: 在喀拉拉，约有三万公顷稻田受到这种杂草的侵害。
